now_playing.title: 生化危机：爆发夜
now_playing.description: 奉命奔赴浣熊市的医疗速递员布莱恩，意外深陷全城失控的病毒浩劫。浣熊市彻底沦陷，异变怪物横行肆虐、嗜血猎捕，身陷末日绝境的他，能否在这场惊魂噩梦中突围求生，搏出一线生机？

now_playing.title: 鲸口脱险
now_playing.description: 一场突如其来的意外，让他被巨鲸吞入腹中。受困于漆黑鲸腹之中，他仅剩 一小时氧气。在与时间赛跑、与恐惧正面交锋的同时，父亲留给他的技能，或许正是他逃出生天的唯一希望。

now_playing.title: 野兽之心
now_playing.description: 一名前陆军特种部队士兵与他退役战犬在阿拉斯加深处遭遇坠机事故后，这对老搭档必须在环境严酷的极地荒野中相互扶持，为生存而战。

now_playing.title: 复仇者联盟4：终局之战
now_playing.description: 灭霸集齐六颗无限宝石后的一声响指，让宇宙中半数生命灰飞烟灭。幸存的复仇者们几近绝望，即使找到灭霸，也发现无限宝石已经被毁，希望似乎彻底破灭。五年后，迷失在量子领域的蚁人意外回到现实世界，并带来了一个可能逆转一切的办法。托尼·斯塔克、美国队长等幸存的英雄再度集结，尝试穿越不同的时间节点寻找过去的无限宝石。然而在行动过程中，过去的灭霸也逐渐察觉了他们的计划。为了挽回失去的一切，复仇者们不得不再次面对一场决定整个宇宙命运的终极挑战……

now_playing.title: 神探之痕迹
now_playing.description: 凡是经过，皆有痕迹。刑事技术警察崔寻走过半个多世纪，与同事屡破大案，这位秉承着“为人民服务”初心的神探，不仅见证了公安事业的发展，更见证了新中国的崛起。

now_playing.title: 重生2
now_playing.description: 孩子遭人迫害的母亲希拉，与妹妹有相同遭遇的哥哥苏诚，联手查明孩子受害的真相。两人以命相搏为孩子伸张正义，也将罪恶与阴谋的冰山一点点拽出。身负痛苦的他们在这趟复仇之旅中慢慢获得重生....

now_playing.title: 什么意思夫妇
now_playing.description: 沈默和天意是一对中年夫妻，正在经历婚姻的第三个七年之痒，锅碗瓢盆的碰撞，终于让积压许久的烦躁、嫌弃和失望彻底爆发，三十天的离婚冷静期，即将奏响他们婚姻的终曲。

now_playing.title: 三国第一部：争洛阳
now_playing.description: 东汉末年，危机四伏，宦官掌权，百姓困苦。黄巾军起，曹操、袁绍、袁术、吕布、孙坚、刘备等乱世英雄初露头角。各方势力争斗洛阳，惊涛骇浪中，曹操、袁绍如何应对？

now_playing.title: 死亡禁区实录
now_playing.description: 一场以 “寻人 + 揭秘” 为噱头的全球直播探险，将各怀目的他们送入一片死寂的荒废电诈园区。夜幕降临后，当死亡步步逼近，他们终于发现，比恶“鬼”更可怕的，是深藏于此的人间罪孽……

now_playing.title: 小猪佩奇·完美假期
now_playing.description: 当佩奇得知今年全家不会去度假时，她感到非常失落。然而一场突如其来的暴风雨，竟将她带到了遥远的中国！佩奇一路解锁奇妙冒险，直到与家人重逢，佩奇拥有了最完美的假期。

now_playing.title: 狄仁杰之狼人劫
now_playing.description: 靺鞨粟末部落狼人萨满劫杀新罗向大唐敬献之佛女，阻两国修好，不想巧遇到边境办案的狄仁杰，狄仁杰与司马小刀、段医师联手，抽丝剥茧，破获了靺鞨粟末部落阴谋，再一次拯救国家于危难。

now_playing.title: 敦煌英雄
now_playing.description: 电影讲述的是一个关于“不忘”与“回归”的敦煌故事，取材自沙州（“敦煌”旧称“沙州”）军民归唐风云史——安史之乱后，沙州一度孤悬河西，与长安联系切断六十余年。此后，沙州军民在张议潮的带领下，穷尽一切奋勇抗击，最终使沙州唐旗高树。影片将用极致电影工业美学呈现大唐纷繁历史中的这段热血传奇，展现为家国舍身取义的少年英雄故事和中国人民千百年所传承的家国团圆梦。

now_playing.title: 一路超平安
now_playing.description: 一位不着调父亲的自洽之旅，老蔡带着他珍宝般特别的儿子上路旅行，去实现梦想。他们沿路向南，经历了人生一般的嬉闹苦痛，这一路不太平，但这一路却超平安。乔杉领衔全明星喜剧阵容，幽默温情展现人生百态。

now_playing.title: 活色生香
now_playing.description: 退休后的薛宝梅、蒋芳芳和梁美心，面对各自的情感困境，依然勇敢追爱，以自己的方式活出精彩人生。

now_playing.title: 新大头儿子和小头爸爸之天眼系列：失控的第七天
now_playing.originalTitle: 新大头儿子和小头爸爸之天眼系列：失控的第七天
now_playing.description: 为了替小头爸爸出气整顿职场，大头儿子借助天眼的魔法瞬间长大，但是到失控的第七天，情况越发难以控制，大头儿子与天眼还会碰撞出怎样的火花？七天魔法将尽，他们又该如何收场？ 　　影片是《大头儿子和小头爸爸》与《天眼》两大国民级卡通联动。

now_playing.title: 生日快乐
now_playing.description: 八岁的小女孩托哈在开罗一个富裕家庭当童工女仆，并与雇主的女儿内莉建立了特殊的联系。从未庆祝过自己生日的托哈下定决心要为内莉举办一场完美的生日派对，她暗自希望借此体验到自己从未感受过的快乐。

now_playing.title: 床下有人4
now_playing.description: 民国时期的上海。杜采薇是电影明星沈雨梦的表妹，也是她的私人助手。杜采薇经常做噩梦，看到床下有女鬼爬出，要加害她们姐妹二人！当她解开心结，了解噩梦的原因后，以为恐怖即将过去。但此时，女鬼再次从床下爬出来，白脸惊魂，利爪骇人……这一次，不是梦！

now_playing.title: 老江湖
now_playing.description: 一起平平无奇的失窃案，却让即将退休的老警井有正（于谦 饰）发现了蹊跷。随着调查深入，所有线索都指向名典集团董事长边居寒（梁家辉 饰）。老井锲而不舍地追查，边居寒察觉危险靠近，亦发起反攻。当“老江湖”撞上“老江湖”，将牵扯出怎样惊人的真相？

now_playing.title: 我想留在你身边
now_playing.description: 古建筑修复师江南山（毕雯珺 饰）对医学院学生李艾（何蓝逗 饰）一见钟情。本以为是一场普通恋爱，江南山却无意发现李艾来自时间逆向的平行世界，彼此的时间线互为倒流——他的明天，是她的昨天。每一天都是唯一的相遇，每一次拥抱都在告别。在有限的交错时光里，相遇即是倒计时，但有些人能够遇见已经很幸运了，与其害怕结局，不如在我们能爱的时候用力去爱！

now_playing.title: 上海女儿
now_playing.description: 上海女性阿茗独自来到西双版纳，试图在父亲曾插队过的橡胶林农场寻找两位下落不明的故人，但一系列出乎意料的奇遇与发现，正在这片热带密林深处等待着她。

upcoming.title: John Wick
upcoming.description: Ex-hitman John Wick comes out of retirement to track down the gangsters that took everything from him.

upcoming.title: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend
upcoming.description: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater challenges ahead.

upcoming.title: The Cat in the Hat
upcoming.description: Assigned his toughest mission yet, the Cat must cheer up siblings Gabby and Sebastian as they adjust to life in a new town. Known for pushing boundaries, this agent of chaos must prove himself or risk losing his magical hat forever.

upcoming.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
upcoming.originalTitle: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
upcoming.description: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go awry when a wild beast appears in the woods.

upcoming.title: The Legend of the Swordsman
upcoming.description: Ling Wu Chung decides to hide from the chaotic world. Before leaving, he visits his friends, a tribe of snake-wielding women warriors. However, he finds that the tribe have been attacked, and their leader Yam Ying Ying has been abducted.

upcoming.title: Happy Birthday
upcoming.description: Eight-year-old maid Toha goes to great lengths to ensure that her best friend Nelly, the daughter of her wealthy employer, has a successful birthday party in this poignant debut feature exploring classism in modern-day Cairo.

upcoming.title: Into The Mortal World
upcoming.description: The classic legend is adapted, and the descendants of the Cowherd and the Weaving Maiden continue to write a new adventure!  The twenty-eight star constellations contain the power of the stars, which can destroy the sky and the earth. However, the Weaving Maiden, who is in charge of the Starry Nights, is greedy for the mortal world, causing the Starry Nights to flee and causing trouble. Years later, the Weaving Maiden's son, Jin Feng, went down to the world for his mother, and teamed up with a young girl, Xiaofan, to subdue the Starry Nights. People and gods together, all the way to the thrills and dangers, the mystery of Xiaofan's life, the truth of the Weaving Maiden's crime also gradually surfaced .....

upcoming.title: The Elephant Odyssey
upcoming.description: The highly unusual trek by a herd of elephants as they diverted from their usual habitat and marched over 1,000 km in China across remote Yunnan Province. They attracted global attention, including live-streamed drone footage.

upcoming.title: Shanghai Wonton
upcoming.description: The film tells the story of a retired father who comes to the park's dating corner to find a marriage partner for his son, but inadvertently gets involved in an emotional whirlpool.

upcoming.title: Angel in White
upcoming.description: In early 2020, when the COVID-19 outbreak struck Wuhan, doctors Yuan Chuchu and Shen Yun joined forces with medical workers nationwide who answered the national call, rushing to the city to collaborate with local healthcare teams in tirelessly treating patients, ultimately containing the pandemic through the country's precise prevention measures and united efforts, composing a heroic anthem of this anti-virus battle.
